entries.title: Tighten pauses and repetition
entries.prompt: Use Cut pacing to tighten this edit. Remove weak pauses, filler, false starts, and repetition while preserving complete words, natural breath, and the speaker's cadence.
use_cases: Remove long pauses without rushing the speaker
Cut repeated words, false starts, or filler
Tighten a specific section you marked

example.request: The middle drags. Tighten it without making me sound rushed.
example.outcome: A reviewable cut at aligned word boundaries, with the surrounding cadence preserved.

timeline.label: Keep
timeline.detail: Resume on a clean word boundary

entries.summary: Tighten a slow section while keeping speech natural.

entries.title: Compare takes and alternate edits
entries.prompt: Use Timeline auditions to cut and show me a few playable versions of this section without changing my working edit. Keep each option comparable, label them clearly, and leave the final choice to me.
use_cases: Compare two takes of the same line
Try different openings before choosing one
Preview alternate treatments without changing the working edit

example.request: Let me compare these three opening takes before we change the main cut.
example.outcome: Playable alternatives for the same editorial question, with no selected winner or changes applied to the working edit.

entries.summary: Compare different takes or versions before choosing one.

entries.title: Create and refine speech captions
entries.prompt: Use Caption craft to create accurate captions for this video. Keep the spoken wording exact, break lines at natural phrases, default to short single-line groups, and keep them clear of faces and platform controls.
use_cases: Add captions to spoken footage
Correct when a caption appears
Fix awkward line breaks or hard-to-read captions

example.request: Caption this vertical clip in short, readable phrases.
example.outcome: A complete caption rail with aligned timing, natural phrase breaks, and one consistent safe-area style.

entries.summary: Turn speech into accurate captions that are easy to read.

entries.title: Visual timing: sync visuals to speech
entries.prompt: Use the visual-timing skill. Time these supporting visuals to the spoken points they illustrate. Let each one stay long enough to read, then clear it before the next idea. Propose the timing changes.
use_cases: Reveal a graphic when the speaker names it
Keep text visible long enough to read
Clear the previous visual when the topic changes

example.request: Make the graphics follow what I am saying.
example.outcome: A proposed entrance, hold, and exit for each visual.

timeline.label: Enter
timeline.detail: Introduce the visual on its spoken cue

timeline.label: Hold
timeline.detail: Leave enough time to understand it

timeline.label: Exit
timeline.detail: Clear the frame for the next idea

entries.summary: Make graphics appear when the speaker mentions them.

entries.title: Sync cuts and reveals to music hits
entries.prompt: Use the beat-aligned-cuts skill. Align the visual changes in this section to my selected music hits. Preserve the music timing and use only the hits I marked. Prepare a previewable proposal.
use_cases: Cut to a new shot on selected drum hits
Change poses on selected melody hits
Reveal graphic layers on the hits you marked

example.request: Make these changes land on the drum hits I selected.
example.outcome: Visual changes aligned to the selected rhythm marks.

timeline.label: Align
timeline.detail: Place visual changes on those hits

entries.summary: Make cuts and visual changes land on the music hits you choose.

entries.title: Balance speech, music, and effects
entries.prompt: Use the audio-balance skill. Balance the voice, music, and effects in this edit. Keep every word clear, lower music under speech, and smooth abrupt volume changes. Propose the mix for review.
use_cases: Lower music that masks the voice
Even out distracting volume changes
Smooth abrupt audio starts and stops

example.request: The music is fighting my voice.
example.outcome: A dialogue-first mix with reviewable gain and fade changes.

entries.summary: Keep the voice clear and the music and effects at the right level.

entries.title: Add sound effects to key moments
entries.prompt: Use the sound-design skill. Suggest subtle sound effects for the marked entrances and transitions. Time each sound to the action and keep speech clear. Prepare a playable proposal before applying anything.
use_cases: Add a pop when a card appears
Match a whoosh to a transition
Accent a reveal without covering speech

example.request: Add a little pop when each card appears.
example.outcome: A previewable sound-effects pass linked to the visual actions.

timeline.label: Sound
timeline.detail: Choose and time a fitting effect

timeline.label: Mix
timeline.detail: Balance each accent against speech and music

entries.summary: Add sounds that emphasize entrances, transitions, and key moments.

entries.title: Plan the music across your story
entries.prompt: Use the music-direction skill. Plan the music arc for this edit: a restrained opening, more energy through the middle, and a clear finish. Keep dialogue intelligible and propose the section plan before choosing cues.
use_cases: Build energy through the middle of a video
Change the mood at a story turn
Plan where music starts, fades, and stops

example.request: Build energy without making the whole video feel loud.
example.outcome: A section-by-section music plan with cue and mixing direction.

timeline.label: Finish
timeline.detail: Resolve the music at the ending

entries.summary: Plan the musical arc, then coordinate track comparisons, cue transitions, and mixing beneath dialogue.

entries.title: Find and compare music options
entries.prompt: Use the music-audition skill. Find three suitable passages from the music catalog for this section and prepare playable alternatives. Preserve the current picture and speech timing so I can compare the music fairly.
use_cases: Compare contrasting music under the same scene
Find a passage that fits the scene’s mood and length
Hear options before choosing a track

example.request: Let me hear a few tracks under this opening.
example.outcome: Playable music alternatives for the same unchanged section.

timeline.label: Compare
timeline.detail: Play each beneath the same section

timeline.label: Choose
timeline.detail: Leave the final selection to me

entries.summary: Hear different music options under the same section of your edit.

entries.title: Clean up and prepare voice recordings
entries.prompt: Use the voice-file skill. Inspect this voice recording for clarity problems and prepare an enhanced version if needed. Preserve the original and the speech timing. Let me compare the treatment before using it.
use_cases: Check a recording for noise, clipping, or sync problems
Compare a cleaned voice recording with the original
Prepare a replacement voice source while preserving timing

example.request: Can you clean up this voice recording?
example.outcome: A reversible voice treatment with an original-versus-treated comparison.

entries.summary: Prepare a voice recording and compare improvements to its clarity.

entries.title: Assemble a first cut from script and footage
entries.prompt: Use the editorial-assembly skill. Build a new edit from my script, source clips, and visual notes. Establish the brief and delivery format, assemble the story in a separate project, and leave me a coherent first cut to review.
use_cases: Build a new project from a script and supplied media
Assemble selected speech before adding supporting visuals
Rebuild an edit in a separate project

example.request: Turn these clips and my script into a first cut.
example.outcome: A separate first assembly organized around the story and supplied direction.

timeline.label: Brief
timeline.detail: Confirm the story and delivery target

timeline.label: Assemble
timeline.detail: Place the source material into a coherent sequence

timeline.label: Review
timeline.detail: Present the first cut and unresolved choices

entries.summary: Build a first cut from your script, clips, and visual notes.

entries.title: Edit a talking-head video
entries.prompt: Use the talking-video-editing skill. Prepare an edit of this talking-head video. Tighten the pacing while preserving natural speech, add readable captions, and suggest supporting visuals where they clarify the story. Keep the changes previewable.
use_cases: Edit a direct-to-camera video from start to finish
Coordinate speech, captions, supporting visuals, and audio
Refine the combined edit after specialist changes

example.request: Make this talking video clearer and more engaging.
example.outcome: A coordinated edit covering speech, captions, supporting visuals, and audio.

entries.summary: Coordinate pacing, captions, supporting visuals, and audio for a talking-head video.

entries.title: Choose supporting shots and B-roll
entries.prompt: Use the planned-shot-craft skill. Plan supporting shots for the marked sections of this narration. Use my supplied media first, tie each shot to a specific idea, and propose placements that preserve the speech timing.
use_cases: Show the object or idea mentioned in narration
Cover a spoken cut with a relevant shot
Choose a still or cutaway that supports a specific point

example.request: Show what I mean while I explain it.
example.outcome: Supporting shots with clear roles and placements against the narration.

timeline.label: Placement
timeline.detail: Tie the shot to the spoken point

entries.summary: Choose supporting shots that show what the narration is explaining.

entries.title: Animate titles and graphics
entries.prompt: Use the motion-graphics skill. Create an animated title for this section using the supplied text. Match the existing visual style, make the entrance purposeful, and hold it long enough to read. Prepare it for preview before applying it.
use_cases: Give a title a timed entrance and exit
Build an animated callout or graphic overlay
Create a self-contained logo animation

example.request: Give this title a simple animated entrance.
example.outcome: An animated title prepared through the appropriate graphics workflow.

timeline.label: Animate
timeline.detail: Choose entrance, hold, and exit timing

entries.summary: Create animated titles and graphics for a specific moment.

entries.title: Arrange text, people, and graphics
entries.prompt: Use the spatial-composition skill. Review the layout of this marked scene. Make the main subject and text easy to read, resolve accidental overlaps, and keep important content inside the delivery safe areas. Propose the layout changes.
use_cases: Move text away from a face or important object
Arrange several cutouts with clear visual hierarchy
Fix accidental overlap and uneven spacing

example.request: This frame feels crowded. Help me organize it.
example.outcome: A proposed composition with clearer hierarchy, spacing, and safe-area placement.

timeline.label: Hierarchy
timeline.detail: Choose what the viewer should notice first

entries.summary: Arrange text, people, and graphics so the frame is easy to follow.

entries.title: Style titles, labels, and callouts
entries.prompt: Use the video-typography skill. Improve the titles and callouts in this section. Match the existing style, establish a clear hierarchy, and check contrast, line breaks, safe areas, and reading time. Propose the changes.
use_cases: Add a title at the start of a section
Label a person, product, or feature
Make small or low-contrast text easier to read

example.request: Make these titles easier to read on a phone.
example.outcome: Readable on-screen text with deliberate sizing, placement, and timing.

timeline.label: Style
timeline.detail: Choose readable size, contrast, and line breaks

entries.summary: Make titles, labels, and callouts readable and consistent.

entries.title: Check a video before export
entries.prompt: Use the platform-video-delivery skill. Check this edit for vertical social delivery. Review framing, safe areas, text readability, and audio, then report anything that needs fixing. Stop before rendering or exporting.
use_cases: Check framing and text against the delivery safe areas
Find black frames, missing media, or caption drift
Review audio and the final hold before requesting export

example.request: Is this ready for a vertical social post?
example.outcome: A delivery-readiness review with issues to resolve before an explicitly requested export.

timeline.label: Inspect
timeline.detail: Review picture, text, timing, and audio

entries.summary: Check framing, readability, and audio before the requested export.

entries.title: Generate and refine visual assets
entries.summary: Create references, test drafts, and review generated images or video before the final quality pass.
entries.output: Reviewed generated assets with saved prompts and settings
entries.prompt: Use Generated asset workflow to create this shot. Inspect our references, stage the prompt and settings, test at draft quality, review the complete result, and revise it against my direction. Promote to final quality when it passes and I have authorized that step.
use_cases: Refine a generated camera move
Prepare matching assets for a sequence
Check a draft before generating at final quality

example.request: Generate a fast camera move through this window. Test it first, then make the high-quality version once it works.
example.outcome: A reviewed draft and, when authorized, a separately verified high-quality candidate with its generation context preserved.

timeline.label: Prepare
timeline.detail: Inspect references and define the shot

timeline.label: Test
timeline.detail: Generate, review and revise a draft

entries.title: Mask Glitch sequences
entries.summary: Link ordered shots with continuous white-to-colour subject masks.
inputs: Incoming subjects or prepared white/colour masks
entries.output: One coordinated proposal with editable masks
entries.prompt: Use Mask Glitch across these shots in order. Make consecutive white-to-colour mask handoffs with no disappearing frames. Keep each subject editable and preview the complete sequence on the timeline.
use_cases: Create a single Mask Glitch handoff
Chain consecutive Mask Glitches across three or more shots
Reuse the old batched pop-and-white-flash variant

example.request: Use these three statue shots in order with consecutive Mask Glitches.
example.outcome: Two registered white-to-colour subject handoffs in one coordinated preview; each mask remains separately editable.

timeline.label: Shot A → B
timeline.detail: B white silhouette, then B colour mask, then full shot B

timeline.label: Shot B → C
timeline.detail: C white silhouette, then C colour mask, then full shot C

entries.title: Rotoscope a moving subject
entries.summary: Isolate a moving person or object with a source-matched mask and check its edges through motion.
entries.output: Source-linked moving matte and verification receipt
entries.prompt: Use Rotoscope to isolate the selected moving subject. Preserve the original and source timing, keep useful handles, correct tracking failures, and verify the mask through motion before proposing its use. Report unavailable masking controls clearly.
use_cases: Remove a background around a moving person
Prepare an object mask for foreground occlusion
Prepare a silhouette mask for changing image fills

example.request: Mask this moving person so I can put changing images inside their silhouette.
example.outcome: A source-synchronized subject matte with usable handles and documented edge checks, ready for a supported compositing workflow. Fill composition is verified separately.

timeline.label: Mask
timeline.detail: Track visible subject and correct failures

timeline.label: Review
timeline.detail: Inspect edges and motion before adopting

entries.title: Track text on a moving surface
entries.prompt: Use Surface text tracking to attach editable text to a moving flat surface. Check the turn, visibility and playback, and preserve the existing edit.
use_cases: Put editable text on a moving note or sign
Fix text wobble or disappearing surface text

example.request: Keep this label attached to the note as it turns.
example.outcome: A reviewable native text attachment with source-bound tracking and checked visibility.

timeline.label: Track
timeline.detail: Prepare corners across the visible motion

timeline.label: Attach
timeline.detail: Propose editable text on the surface

timeline.label: Verify
timeline.detail: Check turns, boundaries and continuous playback

entries.summary: Make editable text follow a flat object in your footage.
inputs: A local video and a visible flat surface
